title: routing.rs: add_newsgroups_header does not validate newsgroup name before injecting into header
description: routing.rs add_newsgroups_header: the newsgroup name comes from the Sieve FileInto argument (e.g. 'newsgroup:comp.test'). The newsgroup portion is used verbatim in the Newsgroups: header without validation. A Sieve script could use FileInto('newsgroup:bad\r\nX-Injected: header') to inject arbitrary headers into the queued article. The Sieve script editor is the only path to control the newsgroup name, but the admin API accepts arbitrary script content — a Sieve script that passes compilation could inject headers via FileInto.
